div.div: Also considered: VNC exporters such as wayvnc for wlroots compositors. A VNC hop loses H.264 and the GPU path, so fastrdp nests Sway, labwc and Wayfire inside an xrdp session instead. Hyprland is not supported (no X11 backend).
